articles.title: From Frozen Cinema to AI Dreams: Dustin Yellin's Sculptures Swim to Life in 'Goodnight Lamby'
articles.summary: Artist Dustin Yellin's glass sculptures become a moving, AI-assisted dreamscape in a new short film starring his daughter Zia. Produced by Darren Aronofsky, it features Paul Rudd and Chris Rock as a talking octopus. The film premiered at Cannes.

articles.title: Behind the Iron Curtain: 'Star City' Reveals the Soviet Dreamers and Spies of an Alternate Space Race
articles.summary: A new "For All Mankind" spinoff, "Star City," explores the Soviet perspective of a space race that never ended. Set in the real training base outside Moscow, it follows cosmonauts, engineers, and KGB agents. The series premiered May 29 on Apple TV.

articles.title: Clear Eyes, Full Hearts, No Movie: Kyle Chandler Reveals He Killed a 'Friday Night Lights' Film at the 20th Reunion
articles.summary: At an emotional ATX Television Festival reunion, Kyle Chandler disclosed he rejected a "Friday Night Lights" movie seconds after his Emmy win. The cast revisited the disastrous Season 2 murder plot and Connie Britton's insistence on protecting the Taylors' marriage. A reboot remains a distant conversation.
